# Prospective Public40 source annotations

These expectations replace unavailable annotations for future runs under the operator amendment in `evidence-amendment.v1.json`. They do not reconstruct the lost file or grant credit to old runs.

The same 40 unchanged public prompts were annotated by two isolated source-only owners. A separate reviewer froze a blind source census first, then adjudicated the annotations without product outputs. The existing formal validator also passed all 40 final rows.

Expected outcomes: 22 commit and 18 clarify. Complexity: 32 bounded, 8 moderate, 0 high. The public set cannot satisfy the unchanged requirement for at least four high-complexity samples. No release qualification is claimed.

`final-predeclaration.json` is the frozen prospective expectation file. The adjudication report and decisions disclose every count or representation correction; the original source census remains unchanged. `custody-manifest.v1.json` pins the source, final expectations, review and validation. Original annotation parts, drafts and isolated source packs are retained in the separate custody archive identified there.

All quality floors, previous failures and the protected final holdout remain unchanged. A fresh campaign requires its own reviewed contract, prerequisites and evidence. This directory does not authorize dispatch or publication.
